Messages.Author: Kevin L Garrett
Messages.Body:
If I play Undead Persistence in combat with Basilia, who has 1
aggravated damage. Do I take any damage from her hand strike for the
next three rounds of combat?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <3mhfii$3...@portal.gmu.edu>,


Officially - no (unless you're fool enough to also play Skin of Night and
convert the agg back to normal damage). Each 1-point agg strike simply
re-sends you to torpor, where you will not go until after UP is done.

L. Scott

Messages.Author: Gary S Cerefice
Messages.Body:
In article <3mhfii$3...@portal.gmu.edu>, kgar...@osf1.gmu.edu (Kevin L Garrett) writes:
|> If I play Undead Persistence in combat with Basilia, who has 1
|> aggravated damage. Do I take any damage from her hand strike for the
|> next three rounds of combat?
|>
|>

I would think that the first point would send your vamp to topor
(allowing you to play undead persistence). The next 3 rounds (assuming you are
able to keep pressing the combat) would result in your vamp taking 1 point of
damage per round (as, IMO, your vamp is already on the way to topor), which could
result in the vamp being burned (as teh damage is aggrevated)

Just my opinion, however

Gary
